**New evidence**
- 2022 Reuters special report on newsroom control around Erdoğan's inner circle.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Special Report-Insiders reveal how Erdogan tamed Turkey's newsrooms","publisher":"Reuters","publication_date":"2022-08-31","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/special-reportinsiders-reveal-how-erdogan-tamed-turkeys-newsrooms-2883337","claim":"After Berat Albayrak resigned, newsroom managers told staff not to report it until the government said so, and pro-government outlets stayed silent for more than 24 hours, illustrating Erdoğan-era media control and self-censorship.","locator":"lines 428-434 in the opened page","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters reported directly from newsroom insiders and media sources; the episode is older than 2022 but the report documents a continuing control mechanism relevant to 2022.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Published in 2022; underlying incident is 2020, but the mechanism is relevant to 2022 conditions.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect but strong: the conduct concerns a family-linked resignation and a media environment shaped by Erdoğan; it does not prove a specific falsehood by Erdoğan himself.","contrary_evidence":["The article does not show Erdoğan personally ordered the silence.","It is media-control evidence, not a direct asset or gift record."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.7","7B.10"]}

- 2022 Reuters/Euronews report on the disinformation bill.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Turkey's parliament debates Erdogan's media 'disinformation' bill","publisher":"Euronews / Reuters","publication_date":"2022-10-05","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/10/05/turkey-media","claim":"Lawmakers debated a media bill proposed by Erdoğan's AK Party that critics said would intensify the crackdown on critical reporting and allow prison sentences for spreading false information about Turkey's security.","locator":"lines 660-665 in the opened page","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters reporting quoted the bill and its legislative context directly; this is a contemporaneous 2022 policy action.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 legislative action.","ruler_attribution":"High for agenda-setting and sponsorship of the bill; the article attributes the proposal to his party and majority, not to a personal draft by Erdoğan.","contrary_evidence":["Government defenders said the law was meant to protect people from false accusations and disinformation.","The article does not prove the law was used against a specific truth-teller in this case."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.7","7B.10"]}

- 2022 official directive to investigate the KPSS allegations.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, 2022 KPSS Lisans oturumuna ilişkin DDK’ye inceleme talimatı verdi","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications","publication_date":"2022-08-02","url":"https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/turkce/haberler/detay/cumhurbaskani-erdogan-2022-kpss-lisans-oturumuna-iliskin-ddkye-inceleme-talimati-verdi","claim":"After allegations about some questions in the 2022 KPSS exam, Erdoğan ordered the State Supervisory Board to investigate and said the findings would be assessed and necessary steps taken.","locator":"paragraphs 84-87 in the opened page","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"The official presidency communications page records the directive and the quotation; it proves the response, not the underlying allegations.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Direct 2022 response to a domestic integrity allegation.","ruler_attribution":"Direct: the directive is attributed to Erdoğan personally, but it is a procedural response rather than an admission of his own false statement or corruption.","contrary_evidence":["The page does not say Erdoğan admitted wrongdoing or corrected a prior false claim.","It concerns an exam-integrity allegation, not assets or gifts."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"]}

- 2023 Reuters report on a 2022 allegation involving Bilal Erdoğan-linked institutions.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Special Report-US, Swedish prosecutors study graft complaint naming son of Turkey's Erdogan","publisher":"Reuters","publication_date":"2023-06-26","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/special-reportus-swedish-prosecutors-study-graft-complaint-naming-son-of-turkeys-erdogan-3113279","claim":"Reuters reported a complaint alleging a 2022 plan in which a shell company would receive large lobbying fees and then fund institutions where Bilal Erdoğan sits on the board, because investors saw Bilal as a path to President Erdoğan.","locator":"lines 422-430 and 455-459 in the opened page","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters reviewed complaint materials and business documents, but independently could not confirm Erdoğan's or Bilal's awareness or involvement; the allegations remained unproven.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"The alleged conduct and contract date are in 2022, but the reporting was published in 2023; useful only as near-period context.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect and limited: the alleged nexus runs through Bilal Erdoğan and two institutions linked to him; Reuters explicitly could not confirm President Erdoğan's awareness or involvement.","contrary_evidence":["Bilal Erdoğan denied the allegations through a lawyer.","Reuters could not independently confirm President Erdoğan's involvement or knowledge.","No kickbacks were shown to have been paid."],"lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.9"]}

- 2023 public asset declaration, useful only as near-period context.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"President Erdoğan’s asset declaration at odds with critics' allegations of massive hidden wealth","publisher":"Turkish Minute","publication_date":"2023-06-03","url":"https://www.turkishminute.com/2023/06/03/president-erdogan-asset-declaration-atodd-with-critics-allegations-of-massive-hidden-wealth/?noamp=mobile","claim":"After the 2023 election, Erdoğan publicly disclosed an Official Gazette asset declaration listing two houses, a plot of land, bank deposits, cash, and a debt to his brother.","locator":"search-result excerpt / article summary referencing the Official Gazette declaration","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium","source_confidence_reason":"The article is a secondary report anchored to an Official Gazette disclosure with concrete figures, but I could only verify the snippet here, not the full article text.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Out of period for 2022; used only as near-period context on the disclosure framework and the closest direct public asset record found.","ruler_attribution":"Direct to Erdoğan's own declared assets, but it does not prove absence of undeclared wealth or 2022-specific asset changes.","contrary_evidence":["The article notes critics' allegations of massive hidden wealth.","The disclosure is after the target year, so it cannot by itself resolve the 2022 gap."],"lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6","7B.10"]}

**Search and rejection summary**
- Searched Reuters, Euronews/Reuters, Turkish Presidency communications, Turkish Minute, TBMM/Official Gazette-related pages, and legal-context sources.
- Collapsed duplicate mirrors of the same Reuters stories and kept one canonical claim unit each.
- Rejected generic corruption-context pages, because they were not Erdoğan-specific enough for 7B.
- Rejected older 2017 gift/wealth allegations and tax-evasion stories as out of period for 2022.
- Could not find a direct 2022 Erdoğan-specific public asset declaration or a clean 2022 record of gifts received personally by Erdoğan.
- The 2023 Official Gazette asset declaration is the closest direct asset source, but it remains out of period for the 2022 dossier.
- The Bilal/Dignita report is the strongest procurement-like nexus found, but it remains allegation-level and does not independently prove Erdoğan awareness or receipt.

**Remaining gaps**
- Direct 2022 personal asset record: partly addressed by the later 2023 public declaration, but not recoverable as a 2022-specific open-source record.
- Direct gifts/procurement benefits tied to Erdoğan personally: partly addressed only through allegation-level family/network evidence; still not proven with independent documentary confirmation.
- Direct acknowledged falsehood correction by Erdoğan in 2022: not recoverable from the open sources I found; the best available items are procedural responses and media-control evidence, not a clear self-correction.
